# Forkline
Forkline is an independent crypto news publication focused on Ethereum and crypto infrastructure.
It explains protocol changes, scaling networks, market structure, governance, and on-chain finance.
Coverage is concise, source-led, and written for investors, developers, and curious users.
Forkline is not affiliated with or endorsed by the projects it covers.
## Key pages
- [Home](https://ethereumnews.github.io/)
- [About](https://ethereumnews.github.io/about/)
- Editorial focus: Ethereum and the settlement layer
